tools.name: formwork_setup
tools.description: Bind formwork shared parameters on Generic Models and create the panel schema. Run once per project before generating panels.

tools.name: create_formwork_panels
tools.description: Create DirectShape formwork panels from selected linked (or host) structural elements. Params: elementIds optional (else current selection), thicknessMm default 18, faceTypes optional, collision default true, deleteExisting default false, includeUnselectedLinks default false.

tools.name: cleanup_formwork
tools.description: Report or delete formwork panels. Params: action (stats, delete_all, delete_by_type, cleanup_orphans), faceType for delete_by_type.

tools.name: copy_formwork_parent_params
tools.description: Copy named parameters from each panel's parent host onto FW_* instance parameters. Params: elementIds optional (else selected panels or all), paramNames required to copy (omit to list catalog).
